label: conj:pachner-pentagon-borromean
title: Pachner $2$–$3$ move = Pentagon identity at Borromean ideal-tetrahedron decomposition
html:
Conjecture (Pachner–Pentagon closure). The Pachner 2–3 move on the ideal-tetrahedron decomposition of the Borromean complement realises the Pentagon identity for \Phi_q at the state-sum level. The -3/4 coefficient of the Markov trace matches the difference between the 8-octahedron and 16-tetrahedron decompositions.

The Borromean complement triangulates into 8 ideal octahedra, splitting into 16 tetrahedra via the Pachner move. Pachner invariance demands that \Phi_q satisfy the Pentagon identity. The conjecture identifies the h^4 = -3/4 coefficient categorically with the state-sum evaluation of this 16-tetrahedron network.
